processes.rationale: Cloud-storage sync. Spikes disk I/O and CPU on file change bursts. Suspend; resume on profile exit and sync catches up.
Peripheral RGB / DPI control. Known for DPC latency spikes from frequent USB polling. Suspending pauses RGB but doesn't crash anything.

processes.display_name: ASUS Aura / Armoury Crate Lighting Service
processes.rationale: ASUS RGB service. Same DPC-spike pattern as iCUE.
ASUS umbrella service. Heavier than just lighting; well-known DPC offender.
Razer device service. RGB + telemetry; same pattern as iCUE.
Launcher background process. Heavier than Steam's; suspending while playing a different game is fine.
Launcher background. Same reasoning as GOG.
Voice/chat. *Don't* suspend if you'll use Discord while gaming. Listed for users who alt-tab less.
Edge keeps background helpers running for sync/PWA. Suspending pauses them; foreground tabs aren't affected if Edge isn't focused.
Same as Edge — Chrome's background tabs / extensions / sync can spike CPU.

denylist.rationale: Microsoft Defender's main process. Suspending AV is the canonical malware tactic and breaks anti-cheat checks. Permanently denied.
The shell. Suspending it freezes the taskbar, start menu, and most input dialogs. Permanently denied.
User logon manager. Suspending it locks you out. Permanently denied.
Client/Server Runtime Subsystem. Suspending it blue-screens the machine. Permanently denied.
Local Security Authority. Same outcome as csrss. Permanently denied.
